recent.text: 2/2 Nets acquired 3 seconds indirectly. After Bridges trade, they sent Mamadou Diakite’s non-guaranteed deal to MEM for ZWilliams and 2030 BOS second. They also sent #36 pick in 2025 acquired in trade (Thiero) to PHX for LAC second in 2026 (Bilodeau) and DAL second in 2030.
